integrity: All equations and numerical checks are reproducible with the embedded verifier. The theorem is proved analytically; numerical checks are supplementary. Earlier specialized equivalents cannot be ruled out exhaustively.
limitations: One standard Brownian bridge, its signed first polynomial moment, one noisy normalized fixed-length interval-average observation with known Gaussian variance, and squared-error Bayes estimation. No unknown kernels, adaptive/multiple sensors, optimized width, or claims of independent validation.
title: An exact noise-driven footprint transition for Brownian-bridge moment sensing
